_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for UNP retrospectives (retro/build_unp.py). Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date. The builder uses the latest history vintage published by AS_OF, the prints published by AS_OF that report a fiscal year after that history (a Q4 print reports the year just ended and extends the history), the latest guide for the current fiscal year published by AS_OF, the latest dividend declaration, and the events published between that vintage and AS_OF. Union Pacific gives its numeric outlook in the 10-K ('Outlook' in Item 7) and in occasional 8-Ks, not in the quarterly releases, so guides are their own dated list. Values are as reported (no restatements), per share as traded on the day (before the 2008 and 2014 2:1 splits). EPS is diluted EPS from continuing operations; a company-published figure excluding a one-off replaces GAAP for that year. A filing accepted after the 16:00 ET close is dated the next trading day ('filed' keeps the acceptance time). Edit only to add newly published facts or fix a transcription error against the cited filing. A stock split ('splits') restates per-share facts published before its effective date (the first day the shares trade on the new basis) for every as-of date on or after it: per-share values are divided by the ratio and share counts multiplied by it. From Q1 2008 the company reports 'freight revenue' in place of 'commodity revenue' (prior periods reclassified); the fields commodity_revenue_b and commodity_pct hold whichever line the print reports, named by revenue_line. A vintage that follows a split may take years from filings published before it: eps_published and shares_published give those years' own publication dates, so the split restates exactly them.

U1.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2006 10-K
U1.supports: selected financial data 2002-2006 (operating revenue, diluted EPS from continuing operations, operating margin and ratio, carloads); 2006 diluted shares 272.0M, effective tax rate 36.4%, interest expense $477M, other income $118M; competition (BNSF parallel routes); 2007 Outlook: commodity revenue growth target 6% to 7%, volume growth 2% to 3%, earnings growth of 10% to 15% and an operating ratio below 80%; quarterly dividend raised to $0.35 on 2007-01-30; 20M-share repurchase authorized 2007-01-30 through 2009

U2.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2004 10-K
U2.supports: ten-year selected financial data 1995-2004 on the continuing-operations basis (trucking reclassified as discontinued): 1998 loss from continuing operations ($0.41 per diluted share), 1999 $3.05, 2000 $3.22 (includes a $72M after-tax work force reduction charge); operating revenue 1999 $10,175M, 2000 $10,765M

U3.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2005 10-K
U3.supports: selected financial data 2001-2005: 2001 diluted EPS from continuing operations $3.65, operating revenues $10,830M

U4.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2001 10-K
U4.supports: 1999 weighted-average diluted shares 269.8M (earnings per share note)

U5.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q4 2005 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U5.supports: company-published EPS excluding one-offs: 2004 $2.89 per diluted share excluding the non-cash asbestos charge ($2.30 reported), 2005 $3.41 excluding the income tax expense reduction ($3.85 reported)

U6.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q4 2006 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U6.supports: Q4 2006 carloads grew one percent; 2005 adjusted EPS $3.41 restated

U7.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q2 2007 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U7.supports: Q2 2007 revenue detail by commodity group (revenue, carloads, average revenue per car), operating ratio, GTMs per employee, diluted EPS and shares, cash, share repurchases

U8.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q3 2007 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U8.supports: Q3 2007 revenue detail by commodity group (revenue, carloads, average revenue per car), operating ratio (76.0%, including a $47M casualty expense reduction), GTMs per employee, diluted EPS and shares, cash, share repurchases (10.2M of 20M), Illinois tax charge ($27M); no numeric outlook in the release

U9.title: Union Pacific Corporation 8-K: quarterly dividend raised to 44 cents
U9.supports: quarterly dividend increased by 9 cents to 44 cents per share, payable 2008-01-02

U10.title: Union Pacific Corporation 8-K ex.99.1: Union Pacific updates earnings outlook
U10.supports: Q4 2007 EPS now $1.70-1.80 (from $1.90-2.00), full-year 2007 $6.76-6.86 per diluted share; diesel fuel and the two-month fuel-surcharge lag; carloadings in the past two weeks about three percent lower than last year

U11.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q4 2007 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U11.supports: Q4 and full-year 2007 revenue detail by commodity group (revenue, carloads, average revenue per car), operating ratio, GTMs per employee, diluted EPS ($6.91 for 2007) and shares, effective tax rate, cash, free cash flow, share repurchases (12.6M in 2007, 63% of the 20M program); 2008 outlook in words only ('post another record year in 2008')

U12.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2007 10-K
U12.supports: selected financial data 2003-2007; 2007 diluted shares 268.4M, effective tax rate 38.4%, interest expense $482M, other income $116M; 2008 Outlook: earnings of $7.75 to $8.25 per diluted share, volume within a range of 1% higher to 1% lower than 2007, fuel prices 15% to 20% above the 2007 average, record revenue and an improved operating ratio in words; capital investments of about $3.1 billion

U13.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q1 2008 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U13.supports: Q1 2008 freight revenue statistics by business group (revenue, carloads, average revenue per car), operating ratio, GTMs per employee, diluted EPS and shares, cash, share repurchases (nearly 3.3M); freight revenue replaces commodity revenue (prior periods reclassified); outlook in words only ('should result in a record 2008')

U14.title: Union Pacific Corporation 8-K ex.99.1: 2-for-1 stock split, additional share repurchase authorization and second quarter dividend
U14.supports: two-for-one stock split distributed as a stock dividend; repurchase of a further 20 million shares (40 million post-split) by March 2011; quarterly dividend of 44 cents (22 cents post-split)

U16.title: Union Pacific Corporation 8-K (Item 7.01): Midwest weather and second-quarter earnings
U16.supports: weather to reduce Q2 2008 EPS by about $0.05, toward the bottom half of the $0.90-0.98 guidance range (split-adjusted) first given in April

U17.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q2 2008 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U17.supports: Q2 2008 freight revenue statistics by business group, operating ratio, GTMs per employee, diluted EPS and shares (split-adjusted), cash, share repurchases (over 6.3M, post-split); outlook in words only ('achieving a record year')

U19.title: Union Pacific Corporation 8-K: quarterly dividend raised to 27 cents
U19.supports: quarterly dividend increased by 5 cents to 27 cents per share

U20.title: Union Pacific Corporation 8-K ex.99.1: Union Pacific increases third quarter earnings target
U20.supports: Q3 2008 EPS now $1.28-1.33 (from $1.10-1.20); Q3 volumes close to 5 percent lower year-over-year; full-year earnings targets will change, magnitude uncertain

U21.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q3 2008 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U21.supports: Q3 2008 freight revenue statistics by business group, operating ratio, GTMs per employee, diluted EPS and shares, cash; hurricanes reduced EPS by about $0.08; outlook in words only ('strong year-over-year earnings growth in the fourth quarter')

U22.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q4 2008 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U22.supports: Q4 and full-year 2008 freight revenue statistics by business group (revenue, carloads, average revenue per car), operating ratio, GTMs per employee, diluted EPS ($4.54 for 2008) and shares, effective tax rate, interest expense and other income, cash, free cash flow, share repurchases; 2009 outlook in words only ('2009 will be a difficult year')

U23.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2008 10-K
U23.supports: selected financial data 2004-2008, per share restated for the 2008 stock split (diluted EPS 2006 $2.95, 2007 $3.46, 2008 $4.54); 2008 diluted shares 515.0M, effective tax rate 36.1%, interest expense $511M, other income $92M, free cash flow $825M; about 22 million shares repurchased in 2008; quarterly dividend $0.27; 2009 Outlook in words only (no earnings, revenue or volume figure); capital investments of about $2.8 billion

U24.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q1 2009 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U24.supports: Q1 2009 freight revenue statistics by business group, operating ratio, GTMs per employee, diluted EPS and shares, cash; no shares repurchased; outlook in words only

U25.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q2 2009 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U25.supports: Q2 2009 freight revenue statistics by business group, operating ratio (a $38M casualty expense reduction), GTMs per employee, diluted EPS $0.92 and $0.78 excluding the RTD land sale gain, shares, cash; no shares repurchased; outlook in words only

U26.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q3 2009 results (8-K ex.99.1)
U26.supports: Q3 2009 freight revenue statistics by business group, operating ratio, GTMs per employee, diluted EPS and shares, cash; no shares repurchased; outlook in words only
